API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the list of all active devices and its basic details
Gets the list of all active devices and its basic details
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices

Gets the list of all active devices and its basic details. The JSON must contain the user’s ID and email address to associate the device to the user. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

userids
integer[]

The user IDs.

emails
string[]

Emails

loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

exclude_loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

exclude_dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

exclude_geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

offset
string

The next_offset value from the last request. You must enter this value to get the next batch from the list. When the next_offset value becomes null, the list is complete.

limit
integer

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 10000

The number of items that must be returned per request from the list.

Default value: 1000
private_ipv4
integer[]

IPv4 Address Filter. It has to be limited to ten IPv4 addresses. Also, IPv4 should be used in conjunction with other filter(s). Conjunction filter(s) include userids, emails, loc, exclude_loc, dept, exclude_dept, geo, exclude_geo, mac_addresses

mac_address
integer[]

MAC Address Filter. Multiple MAC Addresses can be provided.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
Example
SCHEMA
devices
object[]
next_offset
string

This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.
